reviews.name: phase11-spec-review
reviews.note: Caught that terminal settings were applied only after scene onChange (surfaces could start at 14 pt) and a nil==nil stream assertion; the window it reviewed was later dropped.

reviews.name: phase11-ponytail-review
reviews.note: Shared look pickers and a comment move; both undone when the window was dropped.

reviews.name: phase11-e2e-review
reviews.note: Found by hand that ⌘= added 1 to its own last value (SwiftUI keeps a shortcut's first action); no test or reader had caught it. ~12 min of GUI lock, no make e2e (the user stepped in).

reviews.name: phase11-spec-review-2
reviews.note: Asked to keep an Option-types-characters e2e as the guard of the CI-layout fix, and found stale Settings mentions across docs and later phases.

reviews.name: phase11-ponytail-review-2
reviews.note: Comment trims; its should (drop the stored-value clamp) was rejected as outside input.

reviews.name: phase11-e2e-review-2
reviews.note: Found that a ⌘ key no menu item takes (⌘0 at 13, ⌘9) typed its character into the shell, also before this phase; XCUITest could not reproduce it. ~15 min of lock incl. one full make e2e.

reviews.name: phase11-spec-review-3
reviews.note: Found by reading that the key monitor missed ⌘= with Caps Lock or on the keypad, and that dropping ⌘ keys also dropped them during IME composition.

reviews.name: phase11-e2e-review-3
reviews.note: Confirmed the round 2 blocker fixed; its Caps Lock/keypad finding duplicated spec-3 (already fixed). ~17 min of lock incl. one full make e2e.

reviews.name: phase11-spec-review-4
reviews.note: Insisted on a green CI before closing and noticed ⌘= at 32 was silent while ⌘- at 8 beeped.

reviews.name: phase11-verifier
reviews.note: FAIL on the red CI only; it independently guessed the 1x-display cause of the CI-only ⌘= failure.

phase_agent.real_finds: global hotkeys eat test keys; the stale ⌘= test fails before the fix; a tile layout bug in the dropped redesign; an async teardown hangs; manual check of the ⌘-key fix

e2e_review_round2.real_finds: unclaimed ⌘ keys typed into the shell (blocker)

notes: The scope changed twice mid-phase: the Settings window was built (round 1), redesigned at the user's request, then dropped; the phase became 'Font size and menus'. Most time went to a CI-only failure of the ⌘= step, chased through three wrong causes before CI logs (a debug PR) and a frame-by-frame read showed CI's 1x display rounds 14 and 15 pt to the same column count. osascript keys landed in the user's browser and Raycast once; the user then asked a reviewer to stop driving the Mac. The final full make e2e (37/37) ran at 44867ce; the last commit only changed the test and the monitor's key set and was checked on CI. CI run 39740270219 at e2465e1: green (lint, build, test-e2e).
lessons: Find the exact failing step and its values in the CI result bundle before guessing a cause. I read a CI failure as '⌘= is lost' when the frames showed the grid after ⌘+; three fixes (stale button, German layout, ⌘+ as ⇧⌘=) chased wrong causes. CI's display is 1x, so a 1 pt font step can keep the column count: grid tests must allow one side to stay.

Never send keys with osascript/System Events; Oriel lost focus and my keys landed in the user's browser and Raycast, and global hotkeys (⌥⇧B, ⌥.) broke a test far from the cause. Use XCUITest only, and avoid ⌥⇧ chords in tests.

Show a new window to the orchestrator as one screenshot before reviews: the Settings window took a full review round, a redesign and a removal. Build the non-window parts (font size, menus, defaults) first; they survived every change.
